title: 第二百一十八章 大壮我开始怀念乡亲们了第二百一十七章 全村集体送别
content_zh:
第二百一十八章大壮，我开始怀念乡亲们了！
到了离开的那天，天刚亮，柳树沟村口就站满了人。
王大壮和孙菲菲背着行李走到村口的时候，看到了一幅他们从未预料到的画面。
村口站满了人，里里外外加起来得有数百人，从牛寨村来的人穿得五花八门，有人穿着干净的中山装，有人穿了一身新衣服，有人在袖口别了一朵不知名的小黄花。
冯柳村的人几乎都来了，张秀英站在最前面，穿着一件洗得发白的碎花衬衫，手里捧着一把用山花扎成的花束。
李翠兰端着一个粗瓷碗，碗里装着几个新煮的鸡蛋。
赵大柱扛着一袋刚从树上摘下来的核桃。
还有其他村的也过来送行。
他们拿着自家采的鲜花，有的是野菊花，有的是山茶花，有的就是随手从路边摘的一把不知名的野花，五颜六色地握在手里。
王大壮走在前面，孙菲菲走在他旁边。
人群里有人喊了一声“王医生”，声音带着哭腔，像是憋了很久的话终于找到机会喊出来了，紧接着更多的人也开始喊起来，一声接一声的。
“王医生，孙医生，你们以后一定要回来看看我们！”一个扎着麻花辫的姑娘挤到前面，把手里那捧野山茶花塞进孙菲菲怀里，说了这么一句又退回去了。
“王医生，你教我们的那些东西我们都记着呢，以后不会忘了！”一个年轻小伙在后面大声喊道。
王大壮停下脚步转过身来。
他张了张嘴想说点什么，可看着眼前这一张张熟悉的面孔，那些他曾经把过脉、扎过针、开过药的面孔，却又说不出来。
想起那些在他刚来牛寨村时还满脸警惕和怀疑的面孔，现在全都带着同样的表情看着他——不舍。
张秀英走上前，眼眶泛红带着不舍，却努力保持微笑道：“大壮，冯柳村的乡亲们没什么好东西，这束花是姐妹们早上上山采的，你带回去放着，看到花就想起我们。”
王大壮接过那束山茶花，花梗上还带着露水，握在手里凉丝丝的。
他想说点什么，可喉咙像是被什么东西堵住了。
他忽然听到了一个熟悉的声音——是从人群后面传来的一个小女孩的声音，带着哭腔，断断续续的，像是一路跑过来还没来得及喘匀气：“大哥哥！仙女姐姐！”

是冯柳村那个拉着孙菲菲白大褂问她“可不可以不要走”的小女孩丫丫。
她挤到人群前面，跑到王大壮和孙菲菲面前，手里攥着一朵比巴掌还大的山茶花，花瓣边缘有些皱了，像是被她攥了一路，茎秆也是歪的。
她踮起脚尖把那朵花塞到王大壮手里抽泣道：“仙女姐姐，大哥哥，这花花送给你们。”
孙菲菲在她面前蹲下来，声音哽咽道：“好，谢谢丫丫，以后姐姐跟哥哥有空会回来看你们的。”
旁边忽然又响起一个声音，是牛寨村那个最早喝下第一碗药液的男人，他手里端着一碗米酒走过来，把碗递到王大壮面前：“王医生，这杯酒我敬你。”
王大壮接过那碗米酒，没有推辞，仰头一饮而尽。
酒液温热而辛辣，顺着喉咙滑下去的时候，整个人都暖了一瞬。
第二百一十八章大壮，我开始怀念乡亲们了！
王大壮把空碗递还给他，用力握了握他的手道：“大哥，保重。”
content_en:
Chapter 218: Da Zhuang, I’m starting to miss the folks!
On the day of departure, at dawn, the entrance to Liushugou Village was full of people.
When Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei walked to the village entrance with their luggage, they saw a picture they had never expected.
The entrance to the village was full of people, hundreds of people inside and outside. The people from Niuzhai Village were dressed in all kinds of clothes. Some were wearing clean Chinese tunic suits, some were wearing new clothes, and some had an unknown small yellow flower pinned to their sleeves.
Almost everyone from Fengliu Village came. Zhang Xiuying stood at the front, wearing a washed white floral shirt and holding a bouquet made of mountain flowers in her hand.
Li Cuilan was holding a coarse porcelain bowl filled with several freshly boiled eggs.
Zhao Dazhu was carrying a bag of walnuts just picked from the tree.
People from other villages also came to see him off.
They held the flowers they picked at home, some were wild chrysanthemums, some were camellias, and some were just handfuls of unknown wild flowers picked from the roadside, colorfully held in their hands.
Wang Dazhuang walked in front, and Sun Feifei walked beside him.
Someone in the crowd shouted "Doctor Wang", with a cry in his voice, as if he had finally found the opportunity to shout out something he had been holding back for a long time, and then more people started shouting, one after another.
"Dr. Wang, Dr. Sun, you must come back to see us in the future!" A girl with braided braids squeezed to the front, stuffed the handful of wild camellias into Sun Feifei's arms, and then stepped back after saying this.
"Dr. Wang, we remember all the things you taught us and we will never forget them in the future!" a young man shouted loudly from behind.
Wang Dazhuang stopped and turned around.
He opened his mouth to say something, but looking at the familiar faces in front of him, the faces he had checked pulses, inserted needles, and prescribed medicine, he couldn't say anything.
Thinking of the faces that were full of vigilance and suspicion when he first came to Niuzhai Village, now they all looked at him with the same expression - reluctance.
Zhang Xiuying stepped forward, her eyes red with reluctance, but she tried her best to maintain a smile and said: "Dazhuang, the folks in Fengliu Village don't have any good things. The sisters picked this bunch of flowers from the mountain in the morning. You take them back and put them there. When you see the flowers, you will think of us."
Wang Dazhuang took the bunch of camellias. There was still dew on the flower stalks, and they were cool in his hands.
He wanted to say something, but his throat seemed to be blocked by something.
He suddenly heard a familiar voice - the voice of a little girl coming from behind the crowd, with a crying voice, intermittent, as if she had run all the way and hadn't had time to catch her breath: "Big brother! Fairy sister!"
It was Yaya, the little girl from Fengliucun who pulled Sun Feifei's white coat and asked her, "Can you please leave?"
She pushed her way to the front of the crowd and ran in front of Wang Dazhuang and Sun Feifei. She was holding a camellia bigger than a palm in her hand. The edges of the petals were a little wrinkled, as if she had held them all the way, and the stem was also crooked.
She stood on tiptoes and stuffed the flower into Wang Dazhuang's hand and sobbed: "Sister Fairy, big brother, this flower is for you."
Sun Feifei knelt down in front of her and said in a choked voice, "Okay, thank you Yaya. My sister and brother will come back to see you when they have time."
Suddenly there was another voice next to him. It was the man in Niuzhai Village who drank the first bowl of medicinal solution first. He came over with a bowl of rice wine in his hand and handed the bowl to Wang Dazhuang: "Doctor Wang, I toast you this glass of wine."
Wang Dazhuang took the bowl of rice wine and drank it all in one gulp without refusing.
The wine was warm and spicy, and as it slid down the throat, my whole body felt warm for a moment.
Chapter 218: Da Zhuang, I’m starting to miss the folks!
Wang Dazhuang handed the empty bowl back to him, shook his hand vigorously and said, "Brother, take care."
